source_metadata.organization: National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) & National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA)
source_metadata.title: Tactical Rescue Techniques, Aquatic Search & Extraction Manual

methods.water_rescue_wading: Permitted only in slow-moving water (< 0.5 m/s) below knee depth with wading pole and PFD.
methods.throw_bag_deployment: Standard upstream lead throw; rescuer adopts defensive braced stance; dynamic belay to cushion impact.
methods.motorized_irb_boat_rescue: Approach bow-first into current; maintain throttle control; dead-man switch tethered to pilot; bowman spotter with pike pole.
methods.swiftwater_rope_rigging: Tension diagonal high-line across riverbanks using 11mm static rescue rope (30 kN) and mechanical advantage 3:1 Z-rig.
methods.vehicle_water_extraction: Approach from downstream eddy; secure tether line to vehicle frame; break side tempered glass with spring punch; never front laminated windshield.
methods.night_sar_acoustic_triangulation: Acoustic silence drill (HUSH) every 100m; 3 whistle blasts for distress; 2 whistle blasts reply; 3000lm searchlights & FLIR thermal.
